implementationScope: public ImageCraftCore resource-aware DecodedImage finalization contract with public resource-ledger vocabulary; independent JPEG implementation remains package-only and does not advertise the legacy value-only public finalizer
requiredInvariants: All v5 packed, no-copy DecodedImage, exact ImageProbe, source-binding and framework-private resource facts remain unchanged.

ImageProgressiveDecodedImageResourceFinalization and ProgressiveImageDecodedImageResourceFinalizingSession are public ImageCraftCore API, and the ImageDecodeResourceLedger vocabulary required by that finalization is public as well. A normal-import ImageCraftCore test target provides the compile-time visibility proof.
The independent JPEG adapter remains package-only; runtime evidence still reaches the capability only through any ImageProgressiveDecodeSession and preserves source-bound probe/materialization facts.

The resource-aware DecodedImage capability is advertised while the legacy value-only ProgressiveImageFinalizingSession remains unadvertised for this resource-unknown backend, so frameworkPrivateOperationAllocation cannot disappear behind an older finalization shape.
Making the contract public does not make the independent JPEG backend default, change ImageIO behavior, or close Core Graphics wrapper allocation authority.
